description: This file defines enums, data classes, and factory methods for handling benchmark data flow in PyTorch, including benchmark setup, model invocation, and variant parsing.

classes.name: AutoLabels
classes.description: Labels inferred during unpacking of TimerArgs, including runtime, autograd, and language.

classes.name: GroupedSetup
classes.description: Holds setup code snippets for Python, C++, and global setup.

classes.name: GroupedBenchmark
classes.description: Base class for defining benchmark groups with methods to initialize from statements, models, or variants.

methods.name: init_from_stmts
methods.description: Creates benchmark group from free-form statements.

methods.name: init_from_model
methods.description: Creates benchmark group from model setup code, requiring a 'model' definition.

methods.name: init_from_variants
methods.description: Creates multiple benchmark variants from code blocks.

methods.name: _parse_signature
methods.description: Parses function signature string into arguments and output.

methods.name: _model_from_py_stmt
methods.description: Generates a model function definition from a statement and signature.

methods.name: _make_model_invocation
methods.description: Generates code to invoke the model in Python and C++ based on runtime mode.

methods.name: _parse_variants
methods.description: Parses code blocks into labeled variants for Python or C++.
